title: DevOps Engineer
summary: An engineer who builds and runs our delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure, and keeps services reliable.
job_description: DevOps Engineer at Example Ltd, Manchester, hybrid. You will build and improve CI/CD pipelines, manage cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Kubernetes clusters, and keep services reliable through monitoring, incident response and post-incident reviews. Experience with one major cloud provider, containers and infrastructure as code is required. Weekday on-call rota (one week in five). Salary £60,000 to £75,000.

competencies.name: Delivery pipelines
competencies.description: Builds pipelines that ship changes quickly and safely.

anchors.1: Uses pipelines others built and can't describe changing one.
anchors.3: Describes a pipeline they built or improved, what it does and one measurable effect.
anchors.5: Describes designing or reshaping a pipeline (tests, security checks, deployment strategy, rollback) with clear trade-offs and measured results.

competencies.name: Infrastructure as code
competencies.description: Manages infrastructure and clusters with code and review.
competencies.source: Manage cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform) and Kubernetes clusters.

anchors.1: Describes making infrastructure changes by hand in a console.
anchors.3: Describes managing infrastructure with code, reviews and a way to apply changes safely.
anchors.5: Describes structuring infrastructure code for several teams or environments, handling state, drift and upgrades, and the result.

competencies.name: Reliability and incidents
competencies.description: Keeps services healthy and learns from incidents.
competencies.source: Keep services reliable through monitoring, incident response and post-incident reviews.

anchors.1: Mentions incidents without describing their own actions.
anchors.3: Walks through an incident they handled: detection, steps taken and the fix.
anchors.5: Walks through an incident end to end, including communication, the root cause, and the changes they drove afterwards to prevent it.

questions.text: Tell me about a delivery pipeline you built or improved. What did you change, and what difference did it make?
Tell me about a time you managed infrastructure with code. How did you make changes safe for the team?
Tell me about an incident you were part of. What happened, what did you do, and what changed afterwards?

eligibility.text: Do you have the right to work in the UK for this role?
The role includes a weekday on-call rota, one week in five. Does that work for you?

company_facts:
Location: Manchester, hybrid (2 days a week in the office).
Salary: £60,000 to £75,000.
On-call: weekday rota, one week in five, paid separately.
Team: 5 engineers in the Platform team.
Process: this interview, a 60-minute technical conversation, then a meeting with the engineering manager. Most people hear back within 5 working days.
